transcript: Dad's doctor called with the test results this morning and it's not good news, they want to start treatment as soon as possible. I've just been sitting with it all day, haven't really told anyone else yet. Called him tonight and he sounded so calm about it, calmer than I am, which almost made it harder somehow.
